stem: A fintech team is choosing DynamoDB billing modes for two workloads: one is highly unpredictable and one is stable with known throughput. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Use provisioned fixed throughput for the unpredictable workload to avoid adaptive scaling.
Buy reserved capacity before any stable baseline usage pattern is known.
Use on-demand mode for the unpredictable workload.
Use provisioned mode with auto scaling for the stable workload.
Use on-demand mode for the stable workload to maximize commitment discount opportunities.

rationale: On-demand mode fits unpredictable traffic, while provisioned with auto scaling fits stable known-throughput profiles and tuning. Fixed provisioned throughput on unpredictable loads can under- or over-provision. On-demand does not leverage provisioned reserved-capacity commitment economics for stable baselines. Reserved capacity before baseline discovery can create commitment mismatch risk.
